exposure: GLP-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) use in pregnancy
cohort: The cohort consisted of 143,593 patients with pregestational diabetes and pregnancies using data from the Epic Cosmos database between May 1, 2022, and April 30, 2025.
finding: GLP-1 RA therapy in pregnant patients with pregestational diabetes was associated with an overall low rate of malformations but a possible increase in genital and urinary malformations.
mod_finding: Patients using GLP-1 RA were more likely to have a cesarean delivery compared to those not using the medication.
